annotations.title: Hand the tab to the user

description: Hand a shared tab to the user and wait for them. With message, the page shows it with a Done button and brings the tab to the front: use it for CAPTCHAs, 2FA codes, logins, payment confirmation or any choice that is theirs. Without message, it waits for the user to resume a tab they paused (actions on a paused tab fail with a note saying so). Returns when they press Done or Resume, or after the timeout.

message.description: What the user should do, in one or two sentences.

tab.description: Tab handle from list_tabs, e.g. "chrome:812". Optional when only one tab is shared.
